items.note: S1.3 names the copy/gather/scatter/side-injection gates on triples and the result (X,Y)->(-Y,X) with scratch restored, which matches lines 728-738; it omits the per-invocation effect y_S -> y_S + x_S, the forward/inverse/forward stage order and the coefficient cancellation (lines 752-763), so the statement is loose.

S1.4 states that frames commute with pointwise gates and that a route applies D_sink D_source^{-1}; it omits the scalar sign epsilon_w of the signed role permutation (lines 818-822), which matters for the complex network's -Y output, and does not write the global operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}.

S1.5 gives nested nondegenerate labels, sum of changes Wm-2N+2L and L<N/2, but not the tensor/triple-indicator construction, the loss h per central edge, L=Ich, or the exact ratios 100/539, 101/539; 'central-wire returns' is vaguer than the paper's central-wire edges from time 3 to time 4 (lines 998-1000).

S1.6.1 states the endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w)) - M_source(w) = I_m and s = Wm-N+2L < Wm correctly, and the method assigns P_U and -P_{U_a}. But the method claims every edge rank equals the label dimension change, missing the paper's N exceptional source edges of rank one (lines 1162-1165) that produce -N rather than -2N, and the endpoint computation P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I is not shown.

S2.1 gives the phase frames C_U, one translation kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, and s_c < W_c m, but not s_c = W_c m - 2N + 2L_c. It also says the network realises C^{tensor m} on every role without the source/sink diagonal corrections (Z_a signs, i^27) and the undoing of the signed bank exchange that the paper requires (lines 1225-1227, 1300-1314).

The plan has L<N/2, s<Wm, s_c<W_c m and tau = 1-2^{-50} from a deficit above 20*2^{-50}, which is the paper's route. It does not give the exact deficits eta_b, eta_c, does not state the complex bound s_c/W_c < m^sigma, and omits the log m < 20 step (lines 1332-1337) that turns the deficit into the exponent.

S1.1 matches Lemma lem:elementary-streams. S1.2 gives the controlled update and the rational-unit scaling in O(V) with controls before the target, but drops the hypothesis that the offset be preparable in b^{O(1)} time and the prime/denominator conditions (lines 557-567), although its quote contains the former.

Both lemmas are stated faithfully: the E_1 Pi E_2 factorization with a ones, and exactly a interchanges of b-digit fields plus O(V). The plan gives no derivation (Bruhat-type elimination at 1375-1392, the triangular updates at 1412-1447).

The plan follows the paper's proof: cyclic split into W role streams, shear frames Phi_{A_e} on edges via recursive interchanges, H<-H+D on every row, the three updates D<-D-H, H<-H+D, D<-H-D, the recurrence F_k <= (s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with geometric sum O(e^tau), and the fixed-tape parking schedule at O(V) per node.
S1 gives the address permutation (p,h,g,d,z)->(p,d,g,h,z) in O(Vu^tau), and S1.10 sketches high digits as rows, padding and power-width calls; the reduction itself (lines 1649-1762) is not developed.

S2.2 (exactly s_c child calls on the f=e/m axes of one slot, giving C^{tensor e}) and S2.3 (H_0^{tensor D} = b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D) are correct. The plan omits the conjugation by the binary basis change P_M that puts residual directions into coordinate slots (eq:phase-edge-coordinate), the inverse-child identity (C^{-1})^{tensor f} = (-i)^f Z C Z (eq:phase-inverse-child) and the Gaussian-elimination count of row additions.

S2.4 gives the selected-bit XOR, whole-chunk cyclic shifts, sorting repair of a small bad set, restoration of z and the family cost O(V(L^tau+1)). It omits the positions j_i = rho + iK, the bad fraction delta_bad = min{1, 80(f-1)2^{-K}}, the full time bound and the conditions under which it reduces to O(V(L^tau+1)) (lines 2001-2010).

S2.5 quotes the recurrence F(e) <= (s/W)F(e/m) + O((eK)^tau+1) correctly. It omits the leaves F(e)=O(e) for e<d^beta, the q_0 row preprocessing, the base-m partition and the condition max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)} < lambda' (line 2444), saying only lambda'<1.

S2 and S2.7 state the O(Vd^{lambda'}) layer with one truncation and error below sqrt2 2^{-p}. The sub-steps follow the proof: phase-network recursion to C^{tensor D}, packed basis changes, row split with 1/W volumes, the recurrence, guard width ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) from A(e) <= sA(e/m)+E, and conversion to H_0 via eq:phase-butterfly-layer. The uniformity check of the packed lemma's extra terms (2714-2735) is not shown.

S3.1 (roots y^{2r/t}, H_0 butterflies, signed-shift twiddles, entry (F_t^- z)_j in slot rev_a(j)) and S3.2 (layout L from prefix-slot moves and O(p/K) chunk exchanges, cost O(Tp[dK+pK^{tau-1}+l d^{lambda'}])) are correct. Character cancellation F_t^+F_t^- = t^{-1}I, the exact counterparts LBF_t^- and F_t^+B^{-1}L^{-1}, and the error sqrt2 l 2^{-p} are missing.

S3.4 gives evaluation at B_0 = 2^{4p}, the established multiplier, centered residues and the cost O(rp log(rp)), matching line 3240 and the lemma. It says only that ring elements are multiplied; the lemma returns Q_p(fg/r) with error below sqrt2 2^{-p}.

S3 states M_r = (f*g)/(rM) with the right error and cost, and S3.3/S3.5 follow the proof's route (two forward transforms kept in LB order, pointwise products, opposite transform, exact scale by M). The normalization identity F^-(f*g) = M F^-f F^-g and the error propagation 3delta+eta (lines 3422-3473) are asserted rather than shown.

S4.1 gives P_sF_s = 2^{2alpha^2} B_0 P_t F_t A with costs O(tp^{3/2+delta}alpha) and error below p^2, and S4.2 the tensor form with gamma = 2d alpha^2 and axis-movement cost; S4.1 omits the hypothesis theta > p/alpha^4 (stated only later in S5.1.2) and the definitions of P_s, P_t, and the resampling construction (3576-3792) is not shown.

S4.3 gives the chirp a_j and QF_t u = conj(a).(a*(conj(a).u))/T, and S4.4 the cancellation identity with the reason RF^+R = F^+ (equivalent to line 3961) and commutation with pointwise products, matching the lemma; the proof details are not developed.

S5.1-S5.1.2 give b, p=6b, d, K, T, t_i, the sizes, the prime window, T/2<S<T and alpha^4 theta_i > p, and S5.2 the no-wraparound and 2^{3b} capacity. The fixed rational exponents (lambda, c, lambda', epsilon, delta), eta = 1/(4d) and alpha are not given, and the prime-interval estimate (HvdH Lemma 5.1 / Rosser-Schoenfeld) and deterministic search behind S5.1.2 are not shown.

S5.3 gives Phi: x -> prod x_i^{mu_i} as an algebra isomorphism that preserves cyclic convolution, implemented by triangular controlled shifts. It does not define mu_i = P_i^{-1} mod s_i or give the triangular coordinate formula b_i = a_i + mu_i sum_{j<i} a_j P_j.
S5.4 correctly states x -> zeta y with zeta = e^{pi i/r}, coefficient k multiplied by zeta^k, negacyclic wrap turned cyclic, and M_C = (f*g)/T as M_r conjugated by the twist.

S5.5 gives the source transform (linewise A, chirp transform, B_0, scale 2^gamma), and S5.6 the six steps with scales S and 2^{2b+4}S, as in lines 4506-4533. The input digit scaling 2^{-b-2} and the conjugation definition of F^+ are omitted, and S5's own summary misstates the second scale as 2^{2b+4}.

The plan states E_s = 9*2^gamma TL, the disk margins .5/.6/.701, the final error 448b 2^{-3b/4} < 1/2 and the carry propagation, all correct. The intermediate steps E_ring < 5TL, the chirp bound 8TL, E_w = S(3E_s+2) < 28*2^gamma T^2 L and the use of gamma <= b/4 are not shown.

The plan lists the normalized costs of Table tab:costs, the margins with min g_2 = eps c(1-tau) = 2^{-181} = 2 kappa, setup and exceptional sorting at o(Tp), and the absorption of log powers into p^kappa, giving O(n(log n)^{1-kappa}), as the paper does. Only the schoolbook cutoff for small n is left implicit.
S8 states that the bound gives lim inf T_A(n)/(n lg n) = 0 along all lengths, negating the eventual lower bound T_A(n) >= c_A n lg n, as at lines 381-387.

errors.says: Assigning P_U to each vertex (and -P_{U_a} to the sources) makes each edge rank equal the label dimension change.
errors.paper: Rank equals the dimension change except on the N negative source projections: the first edge on X_a has matrix 2P_{U_a} of rank one where the dimension change is zero, which is why s_b = Wm - N + 2L rather than Wm - 2N + 2L; also only X_a sources get -P_{U_a}, other sources get zero.

errors.says: The only decreasing edges are the central-wire returns.
errors.paper: The only decreasing edges are the central-wire edges from time 3 (gather) to time 4 (scatter), each losing h; 'returns' could be read as the undo rows.

errors.says: The whole network realises C^{tensor m} on every role.
errors.paper: C^{tensor m} on every role holds only after source and sink diagonal corrections (Z_a signs and i^{27k}) and undoing the signed bank exchange; the raw route X_a -> Y_a carries C^{-1} on 27 coordinates.
The algorithm scales by S, then by 2^{2b+4}S; the second occurrence of S reverses the remaining normalization (S5.6 has this right).

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound: interchange via the bit network and the s_b<Wm recurrence (S1), the simultaneous butterfly layer via the complex phase network (S2), synthetic transforms and convolution (S3), resampling with retained permutations and the chirp (S4), CRT layout and twist assembly (S5), exact recovery (S6) and the margin-based time count with kappa = 2^{-182} (S7, S8). It thins in the linear-algebra core: the subspace-label construction and L=Ich (S1.5), the P_M conjugation and inverse-child identity in the phase recursion, the internals of Gaussian resampling, and the intermediate error steps (E_ring, E_w) are stated as results without their derivations.
